text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Her racewear, which had been sent 
out for maintenance, came back. No Reason 
seems to have slipped right into it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, simply splendid! Thy armor hath 
been impeccably maintained, I see!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Behold, this vermilion-shining red armor! 
It was well worth having the armorer craft 
it especially for me!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, can't have that, can't have 
that. The cord on my shin guard was 
loose."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when submitting her 
racing outfit design, she was fixated on 
armor. If the motif was a Sengoku warlord, 
hakama would have worked too, but—
choice_data_list: Why were you so fixated on armor?
Why were you so fixated on armor?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hm, did I not mention it?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If that be so, then I shall teach thee! 
Come now, follow closely behind me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We visited the zelkova-lined boulevard 
right by the station. Looking down upon 
the avenue, a statue of an armored samurai 
warrior stood proudly.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A Heian period warrior who started the 
planting of these zelkova trees! You must 
know of this noble figure too, surely?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time I took this street, that 
dignified figure left an impression on me. 
From reading the informational plaques and 
such, I came to learn his name and 
achievements.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! To leave one's name in history, a 
strikingly memorable presence is of utmost 
importance!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Besides, armor has plenty of eye-catching 
elements! When set against a modern 
backdrop, its presence is even—

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourists
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa!! Hey, you! Is that armor the real 
deal?! Mind if I take a photo?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Take picture"? Okay, okay!! Take as many 
as your heart desires!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm! That foreigner departed well 
satisfied, indeed!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It will be even better if my appearance 
spreads across the world because of this! 
Nyahaha!
choice_data_list: So this is the reason why you chose armor.
So this is why you chose the armor, huh.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Half of it, anyway.
choice_data_list: Well then, what about the other half?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahahah! Don't be in such a rush. 
Accompany me for just a wee bit longer.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
They say this river has served as the 
border between nations since ancient 
times.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I hear that countless warlords crossed 
this river to march into enemy lands, or 
clashed fiercely right along these 
banks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing those words makes me reflect on 
the distant past. An ordinary landscape as 
always. But to think that soldiers once 
traversed this very place...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yet, across our long history, those who 
left their names behind are but a mere 
handful...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Many must have fallen without ever making 
a name for themselves. Every time I run 
here, I cannot help but think of them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"A human life spans but fifty years, yet 
compared to the realm under heaven, it is 
but a fleeting dream."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Since we only live once, I want to etch 
my way of life into history... is what I 
think."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Fall in battle, and you vanish into 
obscurity. That truth remains unchanged 
across all eras.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
To survive the battlefield known as 
racing, I want to engrave this into 
myself.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The ambition to carve her name into 
history. The resolve to face the 
possibility of dying nameless.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Following in the footsteps of the 
predecessors who once fought with dreams 
in their hearts.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I will win, Trainer. I swear it upon this 
racing silk.
choice_data_list:
Yeah... As your tactician, I'll make sure 
of it!

Yeah... As your strategist, I will make 
sure of it!

I'm sure you can leave your mark on 
history.

I'm sure you can carve your name into 
history.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I will win, Trainer. I swear it upon this 
racing silk.
choice_data_list:
Yeah... As your tactician, I'll make sure 
of it!

Yeah... As your strategist, I will make 
sure of it!

I'm sure you can leave your mark on 
history.

I'm sure you can carve your name into 
history.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahahah! I have high hopes for you, 
Strategist!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Once I make a name for myself, I'd like to 
have a fine bronze statue built of me, 
too~♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't be opposed to erecting a 
statue of you right beside mine, you know? 
Nyahaha!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kahahah! To receive the Strategist's seal 
of approval is grand indeed!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, indeed! Wouldst thou come a bit 
closer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching as told, No Reason wraps an 
arm around my shoulder and snaps a 
two-shot photo on her smartphone.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, a fine picture! When I have 
conquered the realm, I shall have this 
printed in the history books!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If it's fame you're after, you must make a 
name for yourself as well! Together, let 
us carve our existence into the annals of 
history! Nya-hahaha!
